EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Thunderstorms developed in central Iowa and moved across eastern Iowa during the late afternoon and evening hours of July 10th. These storms produced damaging winds and heavy rainfall across the area. Heavy rain led to flash flooding as the storms moved into the Iowa City metropolitan area.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Dispatch Center reported knee depth water on 20th Avenue. The time of the event was estimated using radar.
